newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hundreds in HK protest Japan's war atrocities.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds in HK protest Japan's war atrocities.

text.p: More than 200 war victims and their relatives staged a noisy protest in Hong Kong outside the Japanese consulate on Christmas Eve to mark the 55th anniversary of the 1941 "Black Christmas", when Japan invaded Hong Kong.
The group demanded Tokyo apologise and pay reparations for atrocities committed in Hong Kong during World War Two.
They called on the international community to oppose Japan's bid for membership of the United Nations Security Council.
Demonstrators handed in a petition addressed to Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto before dispersing peacefully.
